coding_notes: All nine verified successful ACKs receive one label. The existing packet is unchanged and was not regenerated; all 265 packet source hashes and exact typed request/reply/trace, preceding complete edit, same-thread interrupt and receipt file identities were rechecked.

Each ACK has a unique complete structured edit in its preceding accepted same-thread turn. Explicit hunk-rejected candidates are not earlier applied work. No typed PatchApplied-to-commit identity is invented.

Original feature requests, full accepted public bodies, prior snapshots, actual delivered review/validation triggers and subsequent command/result/directive chains were inspected. Purpose is separate from correctness, instruction compliance or equivalent quality.

Invalid multiple-test-name commands and the exact-name zero-test run are retained. A cross-agent owned-test warning is not itself evidence that another agent's tests failed. Assertion order and target-specific filter exclusions are preserved; controller no/follow-up coverage is not inferred from the feature_done filter.

No independent mixed-purpose or missing-prior-state ambiguity remains in these nine inspected groups. Synthetic terminal tests are not described as real-provider or complete end-to-end verification. Native actions are not assumed absent from a public-directive packet; reasoning bodies are excluded and perfect blinding is not claimed.

Prior packets, original/revised drafts, correction notes, reviews and operational notes remain unchanged. Independent review is required before freezing; no aggregate token/quality/condition results, whole-phase inference, provider generation or frozen-file edits were used.
